summary: Russia launched a massive wave of jet-powered UAVs across northern, central, and eastern Ukraine overnight, accompanied by persistent ballistic missile threats from Belarus and Bryansk region. Ukrainian air defenses tracked multiple groups of Shahed-238 and new drone types across Kharkiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Cherkasy regions. Russian ground forces advanced near Maiske, Vozdvyzhivka, and Luhivske in the east while striking civilian infrastructure in Rivne and Chernihiv.
key_points: Jet UAVs penetrated deep into Ukraine from multiple axes targeting Kharkiv, Poltava, Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Dnipropetrovsk, and Cherkasy regions overnight. (Source: @kpszsu/91116)
Ballistic missile threat from Belarus and Bryansk region remained elevated for eastern regions and Kyiv throughout the night. (Source: @eRadarrua/126796)
Russian forces advanced near Maiske, Vozdvyzhivka, and Luhivske according to DeepState map updates. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23937)
Rivne region civilian enterprise struck by Russian drone, causing large fire and one confirmed death per OVA head Vitaliy Koval. (Source: @eRadarrua/126784)
Konotop entered fifth day without power after Russian attack; diesel reserves for generators nearly exhausted. (Source: @UkraineNow/84952)
Chernihiv animal shelter 'Krok do tvaryn' hit by drone; three women injured, one dog killed, three cats and one dog wounded. (Source: @UkraineNow/84954)
Analysis shows Russian air tactics shifted to jet drones (Shahed-238) and concentrated ballistic/hypersonic salvos up to 39 missiles per night. (Source: @eRadarrua/126761)
Italian PM Meloni froze 13th military aid package to Ukraine pending US midterm election results. (Source: @UkraineNow/84940)

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a large-scale overnight air operation employing jet-powered UAVs across at least seven Ukrainian regions while maintaining ballistic missile threats from Belarus and Bryansk oblast. Simultaneously, Russian ground forces made verified advances near Maiske, Vozdvyzhivka, and Luhivske in eastern Ukraine. Civilian infrastructure strikes in Rivne and Chernihiv caused casualties and prolonged power outages in Konotop.

points: Ukrainian air defense monitored multiple groups of jet UAVs (Shahed-238 and new types 'Parodiya', 'Banderoil/Dan-T') entering from north, east, and south across Kharkiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Cherkasy regions overnight 28-29 October. (Source: @eRadarrua/126758, @kpszsu/91116, @kpszsu/91170, @kpszsu/91171, @kpszsu/91173, @kpszsu/91152, @kpszsu/91154)

Kyiv experienced red-level missile threat alert from 01:47 to 02:10 on 29 October; ballistic threat to capital region extended for entire night per eRadar analysis. (Source: @eRadarrua/126803, @eRadarrua/126804, @eRadarrua/126753)

Konotop, Sumy region, remained without electricity for fifth consecutive day after Russian attack; city officials reported diesel fuel for generators nearly depleted, only hospital and water utility partially restored at night. (Source: @UkraineNow/84952)

Verkhovna Rada adopted 2027 state budget with 239 votes including military salary increases; Zelensky confirmed Russian side 'seriously tuned' for trilateral Ukraine-US-Russia meeting in November to discuss energy/maritime de-escalation and prisoner exchange. (Source: @UkraineNow/84945, @UkraineNow/84941)

Zelensky stated Ukraine received only 12 Patriot missiles per month on average from US in 2026; Palisa refused US ambassador post to return to frontline brigade; elections during war deemed impossible requiring minimum six months preparation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84941)

Russian forces launched concentrated wave of jet-powered UAVs (Shahed-238) from multiple directions: Bryansk region toward northern Chernihiv, Kursk/Belgorod area toward Kharkiv, and from occupied territories toward Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, and central Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/91141, @kpszsu/91139, @eRadarrua/126750, @eRadarrua/126751, @eRadarrua/126764)

Ballistic missile threat persisted from Belarus (Iskander-M) and Bryansk region targeting eastern regions and Kyiv; mon1tor_ua reported high probability of Iskander-M launch from Bryansk. (Source: @eRadarrua/126796, @mon1tor_ua/77605, @kpszsu/91142)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern front with threat of aviation-guided weapons for frontline areas per kpszsu warning. (Source: @kpszsu/91148)
Russian strike on civilian enterprise in Sarny district, Rivne region, 28 October caused large fire, destroyed cargo vehicles, killed one man per OVA head Vitaliy Koval. (Source: @eRadarrua/126784)

Drone attack on Chernihiv animal shelter 'Krok do tvaryn' injured three women, killed one dog, wounded three cats and one dog; shelter requested temporary foster care for animals. (Source: @UkraineNow/84954, @eRadarrua/126768)

eRadar analysis of October 2025 vs 2026 shows Russian shift to jet drones (Shahed-238), new types ('Parodiya', 'Banderoil/Dan-T'), concentrated salvos of heavy/ballistic missiles (Iskander-M, KN-23, Zircon, S-400) up to 39 per night, focusing on energy infrastructure in central/eastern regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/126761)

DeepState map update 28 October confirmed Russian advances near Maiske (Donetsk region) and near Vozdvyzhivka and Luhivske (likely Luhansk/Donetsk border area). (Source: @DeepStateUA/23937, @DeepStateUA/23936)
Dnipropetrovsk region tracked two groups of jet UAVs; Donetsk region one group; UAVs observed past Magdalynivka moving toward Poltava region (Kobeliaky). (Source: @eRadarrua/126758, @kpszsu/91120)

Poltava region recorded multiple jet UAV transits: past Novy Sanzhary toward Reshetylivka, past Kobeliaky northwest, and from Dnipropetrovsk direction via Magdalynivka. (Source: @kpszsu/91171, @kpszsu/91169, @kpszsu/91120)

Kharkiv region experienced sustained jet UAV activity: from south toward city, past Zmiiv toward Kharkiv, past Kolomak toward Poltava (Kotelva), and near Rohany/Kharkiv; strike UAV also noted in eastern Kharkiv moving west. (Source: @kpszsu/91116, @kpszsu/91166, @eRadarrua/126750, @kpszsu/91170, @kpszsu/91139)

Russian forces employing 'Susanin' optical navigation modules on drones/missiles for night operations, potentially forcing Ukraine to reconsider blackout policies per presidential advisor Flash. (Source: @UkraineNow/84947)

Chernihiv region recorded intense jet UAV activity: three past Slavutych, one at Kuliyivka, two new on Dobryanka/Slavutych, plus single UAV from Bryansk region toward northern Chernihiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/126785, @kpszsu/91141, @eRadarrua/126757)
Kyiv region tracked jet UAVs at Rzhyshchiv (multiple reports) and from northern Kyiv toward Zhytomyr region westward. (Source: @eRadarrua/126760, @eRadarrua/126759, @kpszsu/91173, @kpszsu/91143)
Zhytomyr region: jet UAV toward Ovruch, another toward Korosten from east; Geran-5 reported on Zhytomyr by mon1tor_ua. (Source: @eRadarrua/126757, @kpszsu/91162, @mon1tor_ua/77604)

Konotop (Sumy region) critical infrastructure collapse after Russian attack: fifth day without power, diesel reserves ending, only hospital and water utility partially supplied at night. (Source: @UkraineNow/84952)
Sumy region not directly mentioned in UAV tracks but Konotop outage indicates prior strike on energy infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/84952)

Dnipropetrovsk region: two groups of jet UAVs tracked, one past Mezova toward Pavlohrad, another past Magdalynivka toward Poltava (Kobeliaky). (Source: @eRadarrua/126751, @eRadarrua/126758, @kpszsu/91120)
Kirovohrad region: one group of jet UAVs launched toward Vinnytsia region past Blahovishchenske. (Source: @eRadarrua/126758, @eRadarrua/126764)
Cherkasy region: jet UAVs near Kamianka and past Zvenyhorodka moving westward. (Source: @kpszsu/91152, @kpszsu/91154)
No specific ground combat reports from southern front (Zaporizhzhia, Kherson) in provided messages. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23937, @DeepStateUA/23936)
Rivne region (western Ukraine) struck by Russian drone on civilian infrastructure in Sarny district, not southern front but notable deep strike. (Source: @eRadarrua/126784)

Massive overnight jet UAV wave 28-29 October across at least seven regions: Kharkiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Cherkasy; predominantly Shahed-238 and new types 'Parodiya', 'Banderoil/Dan-T'. (Source: @eRadarrua/126758, @kpszsu/91116, @kpszsu/91170, @kpszsu/91171, @kpszsu/91173, @kpszsu/91152, @kpszsu/91154)

Ballistic missile threat elevated all night for eastern regions and Kyiv from Belarus (Iskander-M) and Bryansk region; mon1tor_ua warned high probability of Iskander-M launch from Bryansk. (Source: @eRadarrua/126796, @mon1tor_ua/77605, @kpszsu/91142, @eRadarrua/126753)

eRadar comparative analysis: October 2026 vs 2025 shows shift from piston Shahed-131/136 + decoys to jet Shahed-238 + new types; from cruise missile waves to concentrated ballistic/hypersonic salvos (Iskander-M, KN-23, Zircon, S-400) up to 39 per night; drone interception up 85-90% but ballistic interception remains critical challenge. (Source: @eRadarrua/126761)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern front with threat of aviation-guided weapons for frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/91148)
Ukraine may need to revise blackout policies due to Russian 'Susanin' optical navigation modules enabling night strikes without lights. (Source: @UkraineNow/84947)

Kyiv air alert active 01:47-02:10 29 October (red level missile threat); Chernihiv region recorded 3+ UAVs past Slavutych, 1 Kuliyivka, 2 Dobryanka/Slavutych. (Source: @eRadarrua/126803, @eRadarrua/126804, @eRadarrua/126785)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's overnight operation demonstrates evolved air warfare doctrine: massed jet UAVs (Shahed-238) penetrating deep across multiple axes simultaneously, backed by sustained ballistic missile threats from Belarus and Bryansk oblast. The shift from cruise missiles to concentrated Iskander-M/KN-23/Zircon salvos (up to 39/night) targets Ukrainian air defense saturation while new optical navigation ('Susanin') reduces reliance on visible infrastructure. Ground advances near Maiske, Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivsek suggest continued pressure on eastern defensive lines. Civilian infrastructure strikes in Rivne and Chernihiv, plus prolonged Konotop blackout, indicate systematic energy grid degradation. Ukrainian interception rates improved (85-90% for drones) but ballistic missile defense remains critical vulnerability.
sections.regional_response: Italy's freeze of the 13th military aid package pending US elections signals European aid sensitivity to American political cycles. Zelensky's disclosure of only 12 Patriot missiles/month from US in 2026 highlights persistent air defense shortages. The reported trilateral Ukraine-US-Russia meeting framework for November suggests diplomatic track advancing despite Putin's refusal to discuss ceasefire with Finnish/Norwegian leaders. Ukraine's 2027 budget passage with military salary increases shows domestic political cohesion. Konotop's fifth day without power and diesel exhaustion reveals local civil defense limits under sustained infrastructure attack.
sections.intelligence_notes: eRadar's October 2025-2026 comparative analysis provides validated trend data: Russian shift to jet drones cuts reaction time, new types ('Parodiya', 'Banderoil/Dan-T') diversify threat signatures, and ballistic missile concentration (39/night) aims to overwhelm Patriot/SAMP-T. The 'Susanin' optical navigation module deployment would negate traditional blackout effectiveness, forcing Ukraine into costly active air defense or illuminated infrastructure trade-offs. DeepState's confirmed advances at three eastern locations indicate Russian ground operations continuing despite winter onset. Chernihiv shelter strike using 'Banderoil' parcel drone suggests tactical innovation against soft targets. Russian tactical aviation activity on eastern front adds guided bomb threat to frontline units.
